note: Attacker-controlled JP2 file is parsed box by box; the File Type box header (length=12, type='ftyp') is read from the input.
box.length=12 passes the size enforcement since it is within the remaining file size.
boxData is allocated with size 12-8=4 bytes because the File Type box declares length 12 with only 4 bytes of payload.
The 4-byte boxData vector is passed to isValidBoxFileType, triggering the vulnerable code path.
boxData.size()=4; subtracting 8u underflows the unsigned size_t to a huge value, so the modulo check passes incorrectly.
getULong reads 4 bytes starting at offset 4 of a 4-byte buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read past the end of boxData.
